posts.text:
Benjamin Franklin, when asked what the Constitution had given us, said: “A republic…if you can keep it.”
 
The American experiment is never assured. As Reagan said, “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.”
 
The most important responsibility of each generation is to carry freedom on to the next.
 
From my latest episode of Hold These Truths podcast – “Can America Survive Another 250 Years?” – with historian H.W. Brands.
 
#america250

Great powers win industrial revolutions. Britain won the first. America won the next two. Now China is determined to dominate the fourth.
 
In hindsight, it was a mistake for America to outsource so much of its industrial capacity over the last three decades. But decline isn’t inevitable. We still possess enormous advantages – from our innovation and capital markets to our alliances and natural resources – and China faces serious structural weaknesses of its own.
 
I break it all down with @Rush

The second homegrown terror plot disrupted this month. This one came dangerously close to being a 9/11 level catastrophe.
 
Federal authorities say five suspects are in custody so far for planning a coordinated attack on the UFC event involving explosive drones, a sniper team positioned along the evacuation route, and a follow-on assault on the White House. Investigators uncovered the plot just days before it was set to be carried out.
 
Outstanding work by the @FBI and @TheJusticeDept.

All the while, China’s leaders still viewed America as their chief adversary – and they played a long game against us.

posts.text:
#SundayWisdom from Michael Crichton:
 
“There’s nothing more sobering than a 30-year-old newspaper.”
 
Flip through old headlines and you’ll find no shortage of apocalyptic predictions and existential crises that have long since faded into obscurity.
 
The media amplifies fear because fear captures attention – but it only works if we’re willing to consume the news uncritically. A prosperous society depends on citizens who can distinguish between genuine threats and manufactured hysteria.
